description:
Multi-factor target prioritization for drug discovery.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_prioritisation — one record = one gene's target-prioritisation factors.
Key: targetId.
Results: ordered by the sort_by argument; `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Rows with unknown geneticConstraint, maxClinicalTrialPhase are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Prioritisation factors for genes OT 25.09 scored; a null factor means not assessed, never 0.

min_clinical_phase.description: Keeps rows with maxClinicalTrialPhase >= this value; unknown values never pass.

min_genetic_constraint.description: Keeps rows with geneticConstraint <= this value; unknown values never pass.
